descricao_produto: The product is a Hilee insulated stainless-steel water bottle with a built-in straw lid. It is a tall upright bottle, about three times taller than it is wide, with a smooth matte powder-coated body and a flat base. From top to bottom: (1) a rigid matte carry handle loop whose two ends pivot on small pins on the left and right sides of the lid, on the same axis as the flip cap hinge; (2) a flip cap hinged at the back of the lid: when closed it sits on top of the lid as a slanted wedge that rises toward the front and covers the drinking spout; when open it stands upright behind the spout and shows a rubber seal pad on its underside; (3) under the flip cap, a short drinking spout with an oval opening, and a small square latch button at the front edge of the lid; (4) a rounded dome-shaped lid; (5) a narrow ring band under the dome with the word HILEE embossed in the same color as the band, tone-on-tone and subtle; (6) the smooth plain body down to the base. The body has no print, no pattern, no paper sleeve and no label.
